name: Cave of Altamira and Paleolithic Cave Art of Northern Spain
description: Near the town of Santillana del Mar in Cantabria, Altamira is famed for vivid charcoal drawings and multicoloured paintings of animals and human hands, some about 36,000 years old. The listing now includes seventeen other decorated caves across northern Spain, whose deep galleries kept the art well preserved. The original cave is closed to visitors, but you can see a replica on site.
